dedupe_keys.name: measured weather and power dataset for management of an island and grid connected microgrid

description: Danilo P. E Silva publishes measured and forecast weather and renewable-power series used in economic dispatch of isolated and grid-connected microgrids. Automatic stations in southern and northeastern Brazil supply irradiance, temperature and wind speed. The repository describes five data groups per station: meteorological observations, WRF forecasts, joined forecasts and measurements, selected weather variables, and measured or forecast wind and solar power. Forecasts extend one day ahead. Version 2 is publicly available through Mendeley Data under CC BY 4.0, at no charge. The inspected metadata do not state the observation interval, sampling frequency or file formats, and no data file was downloaded. The collection supports checking forecast-sensitive dispatch and renewable-supply assumptions. It can complement model-pypsa after a modeller confirms units and time stamps. Round 1 rejected these records as study-specific data; the documented measurements and forecasts provide a concrete reusable input, so that rejection is proposed for reversal.
